calibration.why: xcorr on pendulum/calibration·50Hz·bus=stagger·ff±0%·gains×1 (one run at zero lookahead, each joint's best-aligning shift): measured 26.00 ms vs nominal 1.25 ms (datasheet:mjbots (fdcanusb ~800 Hz, one device)): off by +24.75 ms, beyond the 2 ms tolerance
calibration.bus_why: xcorr on pendulum/calibration·50Hz·bus=stagger·ff±0%·gains×1 (one run at zero lookahead, each joint's best-aligning shift with the friction look-alike fitted out): measured 20.75 ms vs nominal 1.25 ms (datasheet:mjbots (fdcanusb ~800 Hz, one device)): off by +19.50 ms, beyond the 2 ms tolerance
